sources.quote:
Is it just me or is the AI when doing the career mode just elite FD drivers?
Liki_YouKnowIt? View Profile View Posts Jun 21 @ 5:08am Report this post nah its not you, they will literally wipe out in sync and get a top score for chase. I even get a nudge into the wall and then ai will plow through like im now invisible....... and i get DQ or watch the replay and see points get deducted for off track and im perfectly on the line or im chasing and AI will clearly miiss clips and still score more than me its a terrible win lose system, its not luck or skill its purely programmed #1
Liki_YouKnowIt? View Profile View Posts Jun 21 @ 5:13am Report this post easy for AI to score big on a chase when we have a nice steady lead. Then it has a ♥♥♥♥ lead and makes it difficult to chase so it wins again #2
desertstorm1912 View Profile View Posts Sep 21 @ 9:08am Report this post I cant get past the first levels after the drift school I’ll get a score in the mid 80s and the ai will get 95-100 #3
AutisticPinoy989 View Profile View Posts Oct 25 @ 6:25pm Report this post As others said, career mode is a complete disaster. I tried it and it's really impossible to progress. The AI gets too good even that they scored big when I become the chaser. It's best to do free ride for now. #4
